bennu_avian_lineage.art_direction: Solar-plumed avian silhouette, intelligence carried in plumage pattern and harmonic vocal structure; uncanny grace rather than a decorated bird. No living religious figure is depicted as this species.
bennu_avian_lineage.biology_or_substrate: A non-humanoid avian biology: light-catching plumage used as display and record, harmonic vocal organs, collective ancestral memory carried across generations.
bennu_avian_lineage.cognition: Non-humanoid; intelligence expressed through elaborate light/plumage and vocal harmonic structures rather than a spoken language.
bennu_avian_lineage.individuality: Collective ancestral memory alongside individual persons; the boundary is a live question rather than a settled fact.
manifestations: A moulted feather that still carries a memory
bennu_avian_lineage.origin_claims: Presented as an original NoöPunk creative option for the UCCC flagship: a genuinely strange, myth-informed non-humanoid civilisation. It is not claimed to be the canonical body of Ra, and the mythological analogues are influences, not evidence.
bennu_avian_lineage.phenotype: Solar-plumed avian anatomy; not a humanoid in a costume.
source_references: NoöPunk creative option; mythology used as a creative source, not as factual proof.

cephalopod_diplomats.art_direction: Deep-water envoy in a pressure harness, chromatophore patterns used as grammar. Non-verbal, distributed language; restrained, not comic.
cephalopod_diplomats.biology_or_substrate: Marine biology, carbon-based, with distributed neural tissue.
cephalopod_diplomats.cognition: Distributed and non-verbal; meaning carried in pattern and posture rather than in sentences.
cephalopod_diplomats.individuality: Individual persons with a partly shared sensory model; not a hive.
manifestations: A diplomatic delegation aboard a flooded consulate
cephalopod_diplomats.origin_claims: Terrestrial marine lineage, presented as a candidate UCCC member or a neutral party.
cephalopod_diplomats.phenotype: Cephalopod anatomy adapted to a non-terrestrial pressure and light environment.
source_references: Candidate pool in the codex issue; not sourced to a contact case.

djinn.art_direction: No fixed anatomy: presence indicated by heat, dust, and a bargain offered in a voice that is almost familiar.
djinn.biology_or_substrate: No stable substrate; an interdimensional or cryptoterrestrial mode of existence.
djinn.cognition: Bargaining intelligence; can deceive or ally.
human_folklore_analogues: Jinn traditions across several cultures, in their own variety
djinn.individuality: Persons, with a culturally varied tradition behind the name.
manifestations: A door that was not there
djinn.origin_claims: An independent cryptoterrestrial/interdimensional faction: neither automatically UCCC nor an Orion client.
djinn.phenotype: Variable; the name covers a tradition, not one anatomy.
source_references: Folklore and religious tradition used as a creative source, not as factual proof.

greys.art_direction: Spare, small, unadorned; the uncanny comes from stillness and from a body that may be a made thing. Avoid the comedy mask.
greys.biology_or_substrate: Disputed: a biology, an engineered body, or a projection.
greys.gm_secrets: Assimilation onset is the threshold of the NHI Crisis in play; the codex records the association, not a schedule.
greys.individuality: Unresolved; an individual may be a body operated by another.
greys.origin_claims: Iconic Orion-associated family, but origins and agency vary: a synthetic drone may be a Construct run by a biologic or Noetic operator.
greys.phenotype: Small, hairless, large-headed humanoid in the common account; the account is the data.
source_references: Ufology contact and abduction traditions; separate claim from canon.

men_in_black.art_direction: Under-described on purpose: a suit with no face remembered afterwards. Never a species portrait.
men_in_black.biology_or_substrate: None: a thought-form with a temporary agent or avatar.
men_in_black.cognition: Counterintelligence purpose, if the reading is correct.
men_in_black.gm_secrets: Their operational origin is an Orion counterintelligence effort: temporary Noetic agents rather than personnel. The public record treats them as a legend, and the entry is withheld from player-facing views.
men_in_black.individuality: Not persons in the ordinary sense.
manifestations: A warning that arrives before the question
men_in_black.origin_claims: Modelled as an Orion counterintelligence thought-form, not a biological species. This is an in-fiction reading held GM-only.
source_references: Ufology tradition used as a creative source; the Orion attribution is NoöPunk fiction.

metallic_spheres.art_direction: A seamless polished sphere with no seam, hatch or marking; the interest is in what a swarm of them implies, not in surface detail.
metallic_spheres.cognition: Networked; a single sphere may be one drone in a planetary swarm.
metallic_spheres.individuality: Not a person; a node. Whether a direct or remote controller exists is unresolved.
manifestations: A sphere waiting in a room with no door
metallic_spheres.origin_claims: The default ubiquitous metallic orb intelligence, communications and surveillance network. Possible direct or remote controllers.
source_references: Candidate pool in the codex issue.

mycelial_communes.art_direction: A colony read as a mind: fruiting bodies as terminals, mycelium as the substrate of a person. Beautiful and slightly wrong to look at.
mycelial_communes.cognition: Identity at the network or colony scale rather than the individual scale.
mycelial_communes.individuality: Collective: a strong UCCC candidate precisely because the person is the colony.
mycelial_communes.origin_claims: Presented as a candidate collective-mind civilisation; a biology with a Noetic character.
mycelial_communes.phenotype: Not a humanoid; a colony and its fruiting bodies.
source_references: Candidate pool in the codex issue.

ophanim.art_direction: Nested wheels within wheels, covered in eyes, in motion. Terrifying, not decorative: the eyes follow, and the geometry should not quite resolve.
ophanim.biology_or_substrate: Ambiguous between a machine and a psychic form.
manifestations: A shape in a crop circle
ophanim.origin_claims: A candidate archaic UCCC manifestation, offered as a reading rather than a claim about historical events.
ophanim.phenotype: Nested living wheels covered in eyes.
source_references: Religious iconography used as a creative source, not as factual proof.

orbs_of_light.art_direction: A small light with no visible body; the ambiguity is the design brief. Do not render it as a decorated ball.
orbs_of_light.biology_or_substrate: Unresolved: a plasma-like coherence, a device, an avatar, or a phenomenon.
orbs_of_light.cognition: Unresolved; multiple mechanisms may share one visual phenotype.
manifestations: A light that moves against the wind
orbs_of_light.origin_claims: The initial fiction treats some orbs as plasmoids or possible first-density elementals. An orb may equally be a device, an avatar, a misidentification or a phenomenon: the entry keeps the alternatives.
orbs_of_light.phenotype: Luminous, roughly spherical, no resolved body.
source_references: Candidate pool in the codex issue.

orion_sphere.art_direction: Political iconography rather than a creature: hierarchy, contracts, and an offer that is hard to refuse.
orion_sphere.biology_or_substrate: Not applicable: a bloc, not a body.
orion_sphere.cognition: Distributed across many members of very different kinds.
orion_sphere.individuality: A polity: corporations, clients and assimilated members rather than one mind.
orion_sphere.ontology_absent_reason: A polity, not a body: §43.4 keeps type and allegiance apart, and its members are of many ontologies, so no single substrate is asserted (its own biology_or_substrate reads 'not applicable').
orion_sphere.origin_claims: A political bloc whose politics favour hierarchy, corporations and assimilation. Its members are of many ontologies, which is why affiliation and morphology are separate fields.
source_references: Locked provisional bloc name per the codex issue.

pascagoula_beings.art_direction: Wrinkled, neckless, floating, with claw or pincer hands, exactly as the witnesses described. The interior of their vessel is the original design space.
pascagoula_beings.biology_or_substrate: Reported as a wrinkled, neckless body with claw-like hands and no visible legs.
pascagoula_beings.origin_claims: Witness-described morphology is testimony. The NoöPunk fiction adds a sentient photosynthetic civilisation from Sirius arriving in sublight fusion-drive craft, which is original invention and not historical testimony; deep-time travel makes them distinct from instantly interstellar peoples.
source_references: 1973 Pascagoula witness accounts (public ufology archives); the vegetal Sirian attribution is NoöPunk fiction.

plasmoid_elementals.art_direction: Coherent light or field structure with no anatomical intent. Avoid rendering it as a ghost.
plasmoid_elementals.biology_or_substrate: Plasma-like or field-coherent, not a carbon biology.
plasmoid_elementals.individuality: Unknown; possibly not individual at all.
manifestations: A room that holds a charge
plasmoid_elementals.origin_claims: A lore hypothesis: possible first-density elemental life. The codex keeps it as a hypothesis and does not present it as proven.
plasmoid_elementals.phenotype: Luminous or field-coherent, no fixed body.
source_references: Candidate pool in the codex issue.

pleiadian_delegates.art_direction: Recognisably human at a glance, which is the point: the viewer should keep asking whether the body is the being.
pleiadian_delegates.biology_or_substrate: Reported as a human-like biology; may be a biological-looking representative or a constructed body.
pleiadian_delegates.cognition: Fluent in human public discourse; not necessarily trustworthy.
manifestations: A press conference that makes the news
pleiadian_delegates.origin_claims: The initially common, publicly recognisable UCCC envoys, facilitating acceptance. The entry distinguishes an actual origin from a projected or constructed human-like body.
source_references: Contactee traditions used as a creative source.

q_uo.art_direction: No single image: a voice that is plural. Represent as layered text or overlapping voices rather than a portrait.
q_uo.cognition: A speaking principle assembled from other voices.
q_uo.individuality: Explicitly composite: presented in the L/L material as the combined voices of Ra, Hatonn and Latwii.
q_uo.origin_claims: In the source material a composite noetic speaking principle, not another biological species. The codex keeps the group-versus-species distinction explicit.

ra_social_memory_complex.art_direction: Egyptian solar and bird iconography as remembered human imagery, and a solar thought-form apparition in the present. Do not depict a literal bird species as the answer.
ra_social_memory_complex.biology_or_substrate: Post-biological: a collective whose former biological form is remembered rather than present.
ra_social_memory_complex.cognition: Collective, at the scale of a social memory complex.
ra_social_memory_complex.individuality: A social memory complex: an organisational and consciousness form, not necessarily a species.
manifestations: A birdlike or solar thought-form apparition
ra_social_memory_complex.origin_claims: Modelled as a historically Egyptian and bird-associated representation with a now post-biological status. The source material does not establish Ra as a literal bird species; the avian ancestral form is a NoöPunk creative option, and Egyptian iconography is kept distinct from the channeled collective.
ra_social_memory_complex.phenotype: Not a bird; the avian reading is iconography plus an optional ancestral form.

seraphim.art_direction: Burning or many-winged configurations. Terrifying rather than decorative: the wings are not for flying.
manifestations: A burning configuration in the astral layer
seraphim.origin_claims: A candidate archaic UCCC manifestation, offered as a reading of the iconography rather than a claim about historical events.
source_references: Religious iconography used as a creative source, not as factual proof.

uccc.art_direction: No single emblem: a polity of things that do not look alike. Its unity is procedural, not visual.
uccc.biology_or_substrate: Not applicable: a bloc whose members span every ontology.
uccc.cognition: Distributed across many kinds of mind, with individual and collective members.
uccc.individuality: A polity: communes, collectives and individuals, not a single mind and not a species.
uccc.ontology_absent_reason: A polity, not a body: §43.4 keeps type and allegiance apart, and this bloc's members span every ontology, so no single substrate is asserted (its own biology_or_substrate reads 'not applicable').
uccc.origin_claims: A political bloc whose self-described service-to-others politics coexist with paternalistic social engineering and with human fears of consciousness harvesting. Individuals and offshoots need not obey the bloc's ideological stereotype.
uccc.phenotype: Not applicable; members are of many kinds.
source_references: Locked provisional bloc name per the codex issue; 'Confederation' is a historical human exonym from Law of One discussion, not the official name.
